scope: Add employee-authorized deletion of one product image without changing announcement work.
steps: Extend the product repository, service, and local file-storage ports to delete an image by product and image ID.
Delete and return the database row first, then remove the validated media path; map missing rows to 404 and rely on RequireEmployee for 401/403.
Register POST /api/products/{productId}/images/{imageId}/delete with the existing message response convention.
Add service, handler, router, storage, and migration contract tests, then run focused and broader backend tests without destructive database operations.
